title: Choose owner
purpose: Choose the person who works a nonconformance, or hand it to someone else.
summary: Choose who owns a nonconformance, or hand it to someone else. Only a supervisor can do this. The owner works the record with the supervisors.

tasks.title: Choose the owner
steps: On the record open [[More]] and select [[Choose owner]].
Pick the person in [[Owner]], optionally add [[Reason (optional)]], and select [[Choose owner]].

tasks.title: Hand the record to someone else
steps: On the record open [[More]] and select [[Change owner]].
Pick the new person in [[Owner]] and select [[Change owner]].

good_to_know: The owner works the record with the supervisors and cannot close it.
Until an owner is chosen, only supervisors can work the record, and it cannot be closed.
After a change, the previous owner can no longer work the record unless they are a supervisor.
Choosing the person who already owns it is refused.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Only a supervisor (the admin role included) may open this form; anyone else is refused. It opens from the More menu on an open record, as a dialog or a full page. The title and button read Choose owner while the record has no owner and Change owner once it has one. While the optional nonconformance module is off it answers Not found.

items.label: Owner
items.description: Required. Starts with the current owner, if any. Lists active staff accounts; the person must be an active account with a staff role, otherwise: Choose an active staff member as the owner.

items.label: Reason (optional)
items.description: Kept with the change in the record's history.

items.label: Choose owner / Change owner
items.description: Saves and confirms Owner saved. The history records Owner changed with the owner before and after.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the record without changing anything.

items.label: Refusals
items.description: The same person: This person already owns it. A closed record: A closed nonconformance does not change. A supervisor can reopen it.

items.label: Stale form
items.description: This nonconformance changed after you opened it. Reload it and review the latest details. Your input is kept on the form.

items.label: Signed out by a time limit
items.description: When a time limit signs you out, what you typed here is kept for 24 hours, for you in that browser only, and comes back on this page when you sign in again there (a form open in a dialog opens again on its own page). It keeps the version of the record you typed against: if the record changed since, the page says This record changed after you typed it, and saving is refused with your typing on the form. Copy what you need, then select Discard on the notice, or after a refused save open the form again from the record, to see the record as it stands. It comes back even where the form is no longer offered, for example after the record was closed. A person chosen comes back only while their account is still an active staff account.
